affinity.notes: The glowing blood blade, red pool, and saturated crimson accents create a strong blood-affinity read.

anatomy.notes: The humanoid pose, hands, face, and clothing layers remain coherent despite the dark values.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "mobile blood-blade skirmisher" semantically communicates Blood-Glass Courtesy Duelist (Specialist) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: The slim sword, forward lean, and exposed lightly armored body suggest a fast but punishable melee attacker.

finish.notes: Material definition and focal contrast feel presentation-ready.

framing.notes: The full figure and weapon are centered cleanly and separated from the cathedral interior.

identity.notes: Blind perception "vampire noble" semantically identifies vampires/vampire-noble.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "elite" is accepted for intended T3 under the documented v2 normalization.
